_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Live score sits in Panic; only adjacent rung is allowed, so Denial is the sole upside step while flows and fear keep conviction from flipping directional.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst jumped to Disbelief (invalid); narrative silent on forward phase, so judge enforces ±1 rule and HOLD
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC holds above 78k with fear/greed rising and stablecoin growth turning up without VIX >25
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks below 75k with ETF outflows accelerating and VIX spike confirming lower rung
